description: Sitemap parser, get all URLs from a website's sitemap.xml. Read an XML sitemap (or a site's robots.txt-listed sitemap when you send just the domain) and return its URLs with last-modified dates, or the child sitemaps of a sitemap index. Up to 1000 entries; .gz sitemaps supported. Price: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base).
name: sitemap_parse
